name: 小雪初晴II
english_description: Branded in-game as "SnowMud," set in the world of Wen Ruian's wuxia novels. A byte-level check confirms this is not an independently-built sequel to sibling xxcq but a strict superset of it: xxcq's entire ~2,000-file map (Medicine King Valley/药王谷, the Wen family estate, Dragon Gate) is 99.6% byte-identical here, with roughly 150 extra files layered on top. A live playthrough registered a character (苏晓雪) who rode a carriage to Huayang, walked through the wilderness to the Huanhua Sword Lodge, asked a servant for an introduction, and formally apprenticed under hall master Li Zimu of the "Tiger Squad" as a sixth-generation disciple of the Huanhua sect -- then trained safely against a wooden dummy in Shaolin's training hall. New characters must clear an email-registration gate in the starting wizard-tower room before proceeding, a step unique to this archive. The rank ladder uses Wen-Ruian-flavored titles, including a "护法" (Protector) tier between admin and immortal, and 14 pre-existing accounts already span all four tiers. Unlike xxcq, this archive's SECURITY_D correctly points at the standard securityd/wizlist mechanism rather than a hardcoded founder id.
